group.label: Search Engines
group.comment: Canonical links for products and categories are Magento's own: Catalog > Catalog > Search Engine Optimization (on by default with Zero).

field.label: Structured Data
field.comment: schema.org JSON-LD: products with price, currency, stock and rating (Google's rich results), breadcrumbs, the store and its search on the home page.

field.label: hreflang Links
field.comment: In a store with more than one language (store views of one store): each page names its other-language versions, so search engines show people the one in their language.

field.label: Meta Description Fallback
field.comment: A product or category without its own Meta Description gets the start of its description (about 160 characters).
